'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[2026 Jalisco operation]]
***The death toll among [[National Guard (Mexico)|Mexican National Guard]] troops in [[Jalisco]] rises to at least 25 with dozens more wounded amid clashes with [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] gunmen. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2lp7xwql4o (BBC News)]
***Hugo César "El Tuli" Macías Ureña, a right-hand man of [[Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes|El Mencho]], who coordinated attacks after his death, is confirmed killed in a [[shootout]] with authorities. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/feb/23/el-mencho-mexican-drug-cartel-boss-killing-violence (''The Guardian'')]
*** At least six soldiers and National Guards were wounded after an ambush in the Zamora–Carapan highway, [[Zamora Municipality, Michoacán]]. [https://www.quadratin.com.mx/justicia/heridos-6-agentes-de-gn-y-ejercito-en-emboscada-en-la-zamora-carapan/ (''Quadrantin'')]
*[[Operation Southern Spear]]
**[[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
***Three people are killed in an [[airstrike]] by the [[United States Southern Command]] on an alleged drug vessel in the [[Caribbean Sea]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/23/another-us-boat-strike-in-caribbean-sea-kills-three-pentagon-says (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Religious violence in Nigeria]]
**[[Islamic extremism in Northern Nigeria]]
***[[Nigerian Army]] troops kill five suspected [[Lakurawa]] insurgents near Mayama Hill, [[Kebbi State]], [[Nigeria]], and recover a cache of weapons. [https://www.channelstv.com/2026/02/23/troops-kill-five-terrorists-in-kebbi/ (Channels TV)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch a wave of missile and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], killing four people, including two [[civilian]]s in [[Odesa Oblast|Odesa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/23/four-killed-in-russian-attacks-in-ukraine-ahead-of-eu-ministers-meeting (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Chad–Sudan relations]]
***[[Chad]] closes [[Chad–Sudan border|its border]] with [[Sudan]] after five [[Chadian National Army|Chadian soldiers]] and three civilians are killed, and 12 others are injured, in clashes between the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and militia groups affiliated with the [[Government of Sudan|Sudanese government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/chad-closes-border-with-sudan-after-clashes-kill-five-soldiers-2026-02-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***At least 28 people are killed and 39 others are injured in an attack by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in Misteriha, [[North Darfur]], Sudan. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-darfur-rsf-paramilitary-attack-c7d06dbcb6d7f40139b380de075bf47a (AP)]
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**In [[Ecuador]], seven people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in a rural area in [[Jama Canton|Jama]], while two people are killed at a [[seaside resort]] of [[San Vicente, Ecuador|San Vincente]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260224/2dd65930333040cbbdd46d6697a9ffb2/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Jonglei clashes (2025–present)]]
**[[2026 Jonglei offensive]]
***Militiamen suspected to be loyal to the [[South Sudan|South Sudanese government]] reportedly lure a dozen civilians from their homes with the promise of humanitarian aid and then shot them dead. [https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-jonglei-ayod-killings-3a80749870051de4bcebf2083415dc97 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three security personnel are killed and six others are injured, including some seriously, in an [[ambush]] on [[ambulance]]s by unidentified gunmen in Karak District. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/3-security-personnel-killed-as-gunmen-ambush-ambulances-in-northwest-pakistan/3837896 (AA)]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**Four security personnel and an [[Islamic State]] gunman are killed in a [[shootout]] at a checkpoint in [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]]. [https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5243966-four-syrian-security-personnel-killed-isis-attack (AFP via ''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Panama]]'s [[Panama Canal Authority|canal authority]] assumes control of the [[Balboa, Panama|Balboa]] and [[Cristóbal, Colón|Cristóbal]] ports on the [[Panama Canal]] after the [[Supreme Court]] annulled the [[Concession (contract)|concessions]] held by [[Hong Kong]]–based [[CK Hutchison Holdings|CK Hutchison]], with an 18-month transition period and a new international [[Invitation to tender|tender process]] planned. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260223-panama-takes-control-of-canal-ports-from-ck-hutchison (AFP via France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Peruvian Air Force Mil Mi-17 crash]]
**A [[Mil Mi-17]] helicopter of the [[Peruvian Air Force]] that went missing the previous day is found crashed near [[Chala, Peru|Chala]], [[Peru]]. All 15 people on board are confirmed dead. [https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/15-dead-in-peru-military-helicopter-crash-authorities-1.500452903 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]
*[[2026 Redbird Airways Beechcraft King Air crash]]
**Seven people are killed when a [[Beechcraft King Air]] [[Air medical services|air ambulance]] crashes in [[Chatra district]], [[Jharkhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/chartered-plane-crashes-near-ranchi-7-people-onboard-101771865457647.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*[[Electricity sector in the Dominican Republic]]
**A nationwide [[power outage]] occurs in the [[Dominican Republic]], which the [[Ministry of Energy and Mines (Dominican Republic)|Ministry of Energy and Mines]] attributes to a [[transmission line]] switch malfunction that triggered [[Power system protection|system protection]] mechanisms. Power generation begins to recover later in the day, reaching about 30 percent of normal capacity. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/02/23/dominican-republic-hit-major-blackouts/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/major-grid-failure-triggers-nationwide-blackout-dominican-republic-2026-02-23/ (Reuters)]
*A bus plunges off a mountainous section of the [[Prithvi Highway]] near [[Benighat]], [[Nepal]], killing 19 people and injuring 25 others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39wz97y90no (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-bus-accident-mountain-5c89d3db6c992390cd0dd64c513e1cdd (AP)]
*Six people are killed in a fire at a three-story residential building in [[Meerut]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], India. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/six-members-of-family-killed-in-meerut-fire-101771914635405.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*Five people are killed and 45 others are injured when a [[double-decker bus]] overturns on the [[Purvanchal Expressway]] in [[Lucknow]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], India. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/5-killed-14-injured-as-double-decker-bus-overturns-in-lucknow-police-11126762 (NDTV)]
*A body of one of the three people that were reported missing after a garbage mound collapsed at a [[landfill]] in [[Rodriguez, Rizal|Rodriguez]], [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]], [[Philippines]], three days ago, is recovered. The claims of up to 50 people missing are dismissed. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2186443/1-dead-2-remain-missing-in-rizal-landfill-collapse (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Brazil]] announces that it will revoke a decree expanding the [[waterway]]s in the [[Amazon rainforest]] under a [[Federal government of Brazil|federal]] [[privatization]] program following protests by [[Indigenous peoples in Brazil|Indigenous groups]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-revoke-waterway-decree-after-indigenous-protesters-occupied-cargill-port-2026-02-23/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Slovakia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[2026 Slovak–Ukraine oil dispute]]
***[[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[Prime Minister of Slovakia|prime minister]] [[Robert Fico]] announces the suspension of [[Emergency power system|emergency electricity]] supplies to [[Ukraine]] amid the [[Russo-Ukrainian war]] unless oil transit through the [[Druzhba pipeline]] resumes, following a disruption that Slovakia attributes to Ukraine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/23/slovakia-halts-emergency-power-supplies-to-ukraine-over-russian-oil-dispute (Al Jazeera)]
*[[France–United States relations]]
**[[France]] restricts [[United States]] [[List of ambassadors of the United States to France|ambassador]] [[Charles Kushner]]'s direct access to [[Government of France|government ministers]] after he skipped a meeting requested by [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|foreign minister]] [[Jean-Noël Barrot]] to address comments concerning the [[killing of Quentin Deranque]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-ambassador-france-banned-meeting-french-government-2026-02-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Connections of Jeffrey Epstein]]
**British politician [[Peter Mandelson]] is arrested on charges of [[misconduct in public office]] related to his links to convicted American [[sex offender]] [[Jeffrey Epstein]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cew8jde9pxqt (BBC News)]
**Canadian-American author and former researcher [[Peter Attia]] resigns from [[CBS News]] following backlash after lewd messages between him and Jeffery Epstein were released. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/23/business/peter-attia-resigns-from-cbs-news-following-epstein-backlash (CNN)]
*[[Crime in Ukraine]]
**Seven police officers are injured, including two seriously, in a separate bombing targeting police vehicles at a [[filling station]] in [[Mykolaiv]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/explosion-mykolaiv-injures-seven-ukrainian-police-officers-police-chief-says-2026-02-23 (Reuters)]
